findings.summary: Spec §1/§2 unmet: the six evidence obligations are judged but never performed. EngineSelfGateFacts reads acceptance_runs/mutations/baseline_run/head_run/verification_commands/scope_paths/spec_acceptance_commands from DdControlPlane.get(), none of which that read surface exposes (control_plane.get()/rebuild_status return only status + record fields); a repo-wide search shows these fields are read-only in selfgate_facts.py and written nowhere. No engine code re-runs the frozen acceptance (§2.4), fires the mutation gun (§2.5), or runs the full regression baseline on the frozen base (§2.6). Against the real control plane the gate therefore measures at least five of six facts as absent/negative and mechanically REJECTs every dd single, so the positive self-APPROVE path (线自判默认路径) can never fire; the 50 passing tests inject fabricated facts and never exercise the real read surface.

Spec §4 partially unmet: the templated six-evidence rationale lands in the line's local round record (dd_selfgate node -> append_round, rounds.jsonl) and rides the decision_deliver payload, but no board-card evidence note is ever written on the self-gate path (no Board.evidence/progress call anywhere in dd_selfgate/_ProductionSelfGate/_deliver_dd). The '板卡 evidence note' half of §4 remains unaddressed.
